title: Rav Assi bar Chama

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 93a, saying to Rava: “Thus said Rav Sheshet.” Dikdukei Soferim reads: “Rav Yosef bar Chama (Rava’s father) said to Rabbah: Thus said Rav Sheshet.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Bava Kamma 93a fully writes Rav Assi bar Chama speaking to Rava. This supports Rav for the supplied heading’s abbreviation ר׳. Hyman’s reported alternate Yosef bar Chama speaking to Rabbah and the parenthetical Rava’s father are preserved.

Hyman’s reported Dikdukei Soferim variant and the fatherhood parenthesis remain attributed source claims. The digital paragraph is evidence for the current Rav Assi-to-Rava wording, not a new collation of the alternate reading or admission of a genealogy.
